content:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Threshold breached — api-gateway-us-east reporting 502/504 spike. 5xx rate 13% over 2m, latency p95 > 2s. Auto-pager triggered.
pagerduty: Incident created and paged oncall: ana. Priority: P1.
nana: I'm awake, picking this up — starting triage. Anyone seeing customer reports?
maria: Support dashboard shows ~120 open customer errors across US-East, most are short-lived timeouts to /v1/generate. A few high-volume customers seeing retries.
sam: Observed surge coincident with deploys? CI/CD deploy bot shows no recent canary promotions in last 30m. I see a spike in backend 504s to model-proxy-03 pool.
leo: Confirming: model-proxy-03 ELB target group has 35% unhealthy checks recently. Health check failures seem to correlate with 5xx.
nana: Good, likely upstream/backends degrading. Initial mitigation plan: 1) enable gateway fallback routing to model-proxy-02, 2) remove model-proxy-03 from LB, 3) scale gateway replicas, 4) notify support & customers.
katy: I'll post a status banner and update support org, tagging affected customers.
sam: Executing quick commands:
```
# drain model-proxy-03
aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:tg:model-proxy-03 --targets Id=i-0abc123
# scale gateway
kubectl scale deploy api-gateway --replicas=8 -n prod
```

edge-bot: Edge routing rule active: fallback to regional-north cluster is ready. Can flip via toggle "gateway.fallback.regional".
leo: Removing model-proxy-03 from LB now — doing in 2 steps: set draining, then terminate problematic instances.
nana: Sam/leo: while you remove, can we enable short retries and tighten timeouts at the gateway to avoid head-of-line retries? e.g., 1 retry with linear backoff and 3s upstream timeout.
sam: Pushing config change now:
```
PATCH /config/gateway
{ "upstream_timeout_ms": 3000, "retries": 1 }
```

sam: Applied. Monitoring.
nana: Can someone run a quick curl test through edge after the drain to validate 200 responses?
leo: After drain + scale, curl results: 200 OK for /healthz and 200 for /v1/generate sample. 5xx rate dropping to ~6% now.
maria: Customer impact: top 3 customers reported intermittent failures; all are now seeing improved success rates but some background retries still failing. I'm drafting an incident-ready message.
katy: Status update posted to status.redwood: "Partial degradation in US-East, mitigations in progress. Services may see increased latency and transient 5xx errors."
nana: Good. Next: identify root cause — is it memory leak, GC pause, or network flaps on model-proxy-03? Check pod logs and dmesg.
sam: Pod logs show long tail latencies and repeated TLS handshake timeouts to model-cache service from proxy-03. Also OOM kills around the same window on 2 hosts. Suspect resource pressure + connection storm.
leo: I found a recent image diff: model-proxy image bumped a dependency that changed connection pooling defaults (shorter keepalive + more sockets). Rolling back that image on model-proxy-03 could help.
nana: Plan: rollback proxy image on model-proxy-03, keep it out of LB until healthy for 15m, keep scaled gateways. Sam/Leo proceed.
sam: Rolling back to proxy:v2.14.1 -> starting rollout: `kubectl set image deployment/model-proxy model-proxy=proxy:v2.14.1 -n prod`
leo: Monitoring pod restarts. Health checks coming back.
nana: Also add temporary rate-limiter for new connections at gateway to limit connection storm during recovery:`conn_rate_limit=200/s`
sam: Rate limiter applied. 5xx rate now 2.1%. p95 latency back under 700ms.
maria: Updating customers: Sent targeted email to top affected customers, included mitigation steps and ETA for full recovery (T+30m).
katy: Support queue trending down. No escalations from legal/compliance.
nana: OK, containment looks good. Creating follow-up tasks: post-incident RCA, verify proxy connection pooling defaults, add health-check hysteresis, increase observability for ELB target failures.
edge-bot: Auto-note: Incident will be marked active. Remember to run postmortem template and assign owners.
sam: Adding cluster metrics + dtrace traces for the window and saving logs to /incidents/2767890123/logs.tar.gz
leo: Moving model-proxy-03 back into LB gradually after stable for 20m.
maria: Final check — any data loss or customer config changes? No. All ops were infra-level routing and scaling.
nana: Thanks team. I'll keep the incident open for 1 hour for monitoring, then move to postmortem draft. If error rate stays <1% for 30m we close.
katy: Noted. Posting final interim update to status page. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Incident marked: Mitigated — monitoring (P1 -> active, containment complete).
